title: Lever Hall
brief: Walk a hall with laser beams and a guard, bump three levers to switch the beams off and open the shutter, then reach the exit.

title: Combination Lock
brief: Tap three dials to cycle their digits to the posted combination before the tap budget runs out; the vault door opens and shows the treasure.

title: Relay Gates
brief: Tap the generator fast enough to build charge against its drain; the power hops through three relays, opens the shutter and lights the beacon before the blackout.

title: Toll Gates
brief: Collect coins while dodging sweepers and pay a coin toll at each plate to open the next gate, then reach the exit.

title: Rail Switches
brief: Flip a track junction so each red or blue train reaches its own depot; deliver six trains and do not send three to the wrong place.

title: Lighthouse Lamps
brief: Watch four lamps glow in a secret order and tap them in that order; a mistake costs a life and replays the pattern, and four correct taps win.

title: Airlock Run
brief: Cross two airlocks by cycling their consoles (only one door of each is ever open) past patrolling sentries to the escape pod before the air runs out.

title: Power Grid
brief: A 3x3 board of lights where tapping a cell flips it and its neighbours; switch every light off within twelve taps.

title: Plate Rooms
brief: Step a hero one cell per tap through three rooms: pressure plates toggle the red and blue gates, a guard patrols the middle room, and moves are limited.

title: Vault Keys
brief: Steer through a grid vault, pick up two keys that open two doors while avoiding two guards, and reach the exit with both keys before too many wall bumps.

title: Tower Floors
brief: Two floors: first a key, a shutter, a lever and a laser beam; then a grid room where three pressure plates open the vault door to the exit.
